 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras
 Dated: 18.08.2023

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Madras
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Coram 
 The Honourable Mr. Justice K.Rajasekar
 C.M.A.No.2042 of 2017
 United India Insurance Co. Ltd.,
 Kallkurichi.

Civil Miscellaneous Appeal filed under section 173 of   Act, to set aside the decree and judgment dated 11.03.2023 made in  MACTOP No.136 of 1997 on the file of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal  passed by Additional Tribunal Judge, Viruddhachalam and be pleased   dismiss the said claim petition.
For Respondents : R1  No appearance  R2  Died

It is reported by the learned counsel appearing for the appellant/Insurance Company that the second respondent, who is one of the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis claimant before the Tribunal has died and Insurance company is not able to bring the legal heirs of the second respondent on record.
2. This appeal is filed challenging the award granting compensation to the claimants/respondents 1 and 2.

In view of the fact that the 2nd respondent is died, the appellant is not able to bring the legal heirs of the second respondent (claimant No.2), and the award is also passed in favour of the two claimants, this appeal could not be proceeded against one claimant alone.
Hence, this appeal is to be dismissed for not taking steps against the respondent.
Accordingly, this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is dismissed.
To The Motor Accident Claims Tribunal Additional Tribunal Judge, Viruddhachalam.
